scope: Post-bound experiment on the 844 sealed ordinary and role-replacement direction records of the ordered landmark study. Reuse the same source observations, role candidates, sampling, and four annotated endpoints where available. Targets and FINAL never enter prediction.
lexical: One shared point backbone, seven cyclic orders of the same seven names. Each class compared to the other names on the same physical seed across every position. Decode four interleaved groups of 256 fixed seed identities in every order. Use mean-centered class logits with log-mean-exp over subtokens. No candidate geometry from these text lists enters selection.
selection: Use the previous full, subject-only and reference-only PCA candidate geometries. For a noun to qualify, its score must beat every other class on the mean contained unique seed evidence. Only physically separated left/right pairs may vote. Use nearest admissible candidate only for an explicit immediate neighbor, optical depth extremes only for an explicit superlative. Keep v1 subject if it overlaps a feasible subject by >.25. If either role has no qualifying evidence, use the full v1 decision.
geometry: Complete only an axis observed from one side. Draw measured extents from disjoint in-scene boxes where the corresponding intrinsic horizontal axis has same-class returns on both sides. With a larger median donor extent, preserve the observed face and extend only the other face. Compare fixed-size, symmetric expansion, class-blind donors, and wrong spatial assignments. Use the same unique LiDAR sample and source model for each arm.
metrics: All predictions sealed before official and independent identity scoring. Strict >.25/.50 rescue, harm, six ordinary directions, exact pair identity and four endpoints, per-recording paired uncertainty, selection and geometry separately. To count a new out-of-pool Acc@50 rescue, require same verified physical identity and no passing raw or PCA F/T/R or any of the lexical decoder proposals. No labels for readout, configuration or test updates.
